title: Purple Team Checkpoint Schema
description: Schema for purple team multi-session checkpoint artifacts. Contains 7 base fields (Phase 4) plus 12 extension fields organized into three groups: cross-skill coordination (Handoff pattern, 4 fields), exchange state (Red-Blue pattern, 3 fields), and loop state (Purple Automation pattern, 5 fields). Canonical storage path: work/exercises/{exercise-id}/checkpoints/checkpoint-s{N}.yaml

session_id.description: Unique session identifier. Format: purple-{engagement-id}-s{N} where N is the session number.

phase_completed.description: Last fully completed phase number. Purple team exercises use phases 1-8 (lifecycle phases).

artifacts_produced.description: File paths to all artifacts produced in this session (YARA rules, Sigma rules, detection reports, IOC bundles, etc.). All paths must resolve to existing files at session resumption (RV-02 per handoff protocol).

agent_handoff_state.description: Per-agent completion status and last handoff data. Keys are agent names (kebab-case), values are status objects indicating which agents produced output and which handoffs are pending.

status.description: Agent completion status for this session.

last_handoff.description: Last handoff data from this agent, if any.

artifacts.description: Artifact paths produced by this specific agent.

next_phase_entry_point.description: Phase number and entry criteria for the next session. Example: 'Phase 5: requires Phase 4 detection rules and coverage matrix'.

d3fend_coverage_baseline.description: Running D3FEND coverage matrix state from blue-d3fend. Contains technique IDs mapped and gaps identified.

d3fend_countermeasures.description: D3FEND countermeasure IDs mapped to this technique.

confidence.description: Coverage confidence level per D3FEND Coverage Matrix taxonomy.

techniques_mapped.description: ATT&CK techniques mapped to D3FEND countermeasures.

gaps_identified.description: ATT&CK technique IDs with no D3FEND countermeasure mapping.

d3fend_tactics_covered.description: D3FEND tactics with at least one countermeasure mapped.

token_usage.description: Actual token consumption for the completed session.

work_tokens.description: Tokens consumed by agent work (prompts, reasoning, tool calls).

framework_overhead.description: Tokens consumed by framework enforcement layers (L1-L5).

skills_involved.description: Skills participating in this cross-skill exercise.

integration_point.description: Integration point identifier (e.g., IP-5, IP-6, IP-7).

artifacts.description: Artifact paths transferred in this handoff.

trust_level.description: Trust classification of the transferred data.

cross_skill_handoffs_completed.description: Integration point handoffs completed during this session.

prerequisite_artifacts.description: Artifacts that must exist before this handoff can proceed.

reason_pending.description: Why this handoff could not complete in the current session.

pending_cross_skill_handoffs.description: Integration point handoffs pending for the next session.

red_team_findings_digest.description: Digest of red team findings for quick orientation without loading full RBEE envelopes.

finding_count.description: Total number of findings from red team engagement.

technique_ids.description: ATT&CK technique IDs observed in findings.

severity_distribution.description: Count of findings by severity level.

exchange_envelope_manifest.description: Manifest of exchange envelopes produced. Tracks RBEE, CFE, and DGE envelope counts and paths.

rbee_count.description: Number of Red-to-Blue Exchange Envelopes (one per ATT&CK technique).

manifest_path.description: Path to the exchange directory manifest.yaml file. Format: work/purple-team/exchange/{engagement-id}/manifest.yaml

coverage_delta.description: Pre/post-exercise coverage change tracking for measuring exercise effectiveness.

verified_detection_rate.description: Verified detection rate before this session's work.

gap_count.description: Number of detection gaps before this session.

verified_detection_rate.description: Verified detection rate after this session's work.

gap_count.description: Number of detection gaps after this session.

detection_rate_delta.description: Change in verified detection rate (current - previous). Positive = improvement.

gaps_closed.description: Number of detection gaps closed during this session.

rules_created.description: Number of new detection rules created.

rules_validated.description: Number of rules that passed validation.

rules_untestable.description: Number of rules that could not be validated (missing Tier C infrastructure).

emulation_manifest.description: Phase A technique-artifact-indicator mapping from red team emulation. Maps ATT&CK techniques to their execution artifacts and extracted indicators.

artifact_paths.description: Paths to emulation artifacts for this technique.

indicators.description: Indicators extracted from emulation of this technique.

techniques.description: Emulated techniques with artifact and indicator mappings.

agent_contributions.description: Agent name to technique IDs mapping. Derivable from techniques array (EM-07).

artifact_count.description: Total artifact count. Must match sum of all artifact_paths arrays (EM-08).

detection_inventory.description: Current rule inventory with paths and validation status. Tracks all detection rules across rule types.

path.description: File path to the rule artifact.

validation_status.description: Current validation status of this rule.

rules.description: All detection rules in the current inventory.

total_count.description: Total number of rules in inventory.

validated_count.description: Number of rules with validation_status = validated.

verified_detection_rate.description: Verified detection rate at end of this iteration.

delta_from_previous.description: Change in verified_detection_rate from previous iteration. Used for plateau detection (delta < 0.05 for 2 consecutive iterations triggers termination).

iteration_history.description: Array of iteration records for plateau detection. Each entry captures the state at the end of one emulation-validation-gap loop iteration.

coverage_dashboard.description: Latest coverage dashboard snapshot for quick session-start orientation. Contains minimum required fields per Coverage Dashboard Schema.

verified_detection_rate.description: Primary termination metric per CFE normative mapping. Ratio of techniques with FULL_DETECTION status to total emulated techniques.

detection_rate.description: Situational awareness metric including partial detections.

iteration_number.description: Current loop iteration number for plateau detection.

validation_ratio.description: Ratio of validated techniques to total techniques. When < 0.50, dashboard is DEGRADED_CONFIDENCE.

confidence_qualifier.description: Dashboard confidence level. DEGRADED_CONFIDENCE when validation_ratio < 0.50.

loop_state.description: Current position in the purple team automation loop (Phases A-E). Tracks iteration progress and termination conditions.

current_phase.description: Current loop phase. A=Emulation, B=Detection Validation, C=Coverage Assessment, D=Gap-Targeted Rule Generation, E=Re-Validation.

iteration_number.description: Current iteration number (1-based). Maximum 3 iterations per termination ceiling.

target_detection_rate.description: Target verified detection rate for termination (default: 0.80).

termination_reason.description: Reason for loop termination, if terminated. Precedence: user > target_met > ceiling > plateau. Null if loop is still active.
